brief.audience: Vietnamese women aged 22-30 with overloaded skincare routines
brief.product_truth: Frosted blue-gray glass serum bottle; exact packshot not yet supplied

prompt.job: Create a conversion-focused skincare product hero
prompt.single_idea: Stable skin makes the routine feel lighter
prompt.subject_action: One frosted blue-gray serum bottle standing with believable weight
prompt.scene: Morning bathroom window light with a restrained translucent membrane metaphor
prompt.composition: Product slightly right of center with a clear left copy field
prompt.camera_geometry: Camera at label height with a three-quarter product angle
prompt.lens_distance: 90-105mm product-lens behavior from a low-distortion working distance
prompt.focus_depth: f/8 depth intent with bottle silhouette, closure, and known material planes sharp
prompt.motion_shutter: Static product with no motion blur
prompt.sensor_color: Clean ISO 100-200 texture and neutral daylight balance
prompt.lighting: Broad top-front diffusion with two side cards defining frosted-glass edges
prompt.fill_separation: Low frontal fill with controlled reflection density
prompt.background_treatment: Neutral seamless background separated from the bottle with a grounded contact shadow
prompt.materials: Believable frosted glass thickness, refraction, and surface texture
prompt.locks: Known color and material only; packaging remains concept art
prompt.negative_constraints: No fake label, petals, splash, marble, floating bottle, or generic pastel pedestal
